instruction: Send $30 to each of my roommates via venmo with a note, "For Drinks". Refill venmo balance if you need to.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship="roommate"); the problem enumerates three roommates (the runtime count comes from the search response, and the reference loops pagination). Roommate-to-email links are static structural facts gated by (contacts-searched rel-roommate). The balance is not modeled numerically: the ground truth shows a venmo.BankTransfer was required, so venmo.create_transaction requires (balance-refilled), which is only achievable through show_venmo_balance -> show_payment_cards -> add_to_venmo_balance with the computed shortfall amount; a single refill is enforced via (not (balance-refilled)). Payment cards are untouched (only read). supervisor-complete-task takes the three roommate records plus amount/note as non-API parameters so its precondition can express the full goal with distinct persons (uses :equality); it is the only action that sets (task-completed) and every other action requires (not (task-completed)).

warnings: domain: pddl-lib parser: types ['object'] of term Variable(c) are not in available types {'email', 'payment-card', 'username', 'token', 'relationship', 'app', 'person', 'card-field', 'password', 'amount', 'note'}

plan: (venmo-add-payment-card new-card-name new-card-owner new-card-number new-card-year new-card-month new-card-cvv venmo-token venmo-card)
(venmo-create-transaction roommate-1-email amount-30 venmo-token note-for-drinks roommate-1 rel-roommate)
(venmo-create-transaction roommate-2-email amount-30 venmo-token note-for-drinks roommate-2 rel-roommate)
(venmo-create-transaction roommate-3-email amount-30 venmo-token note-for-drinks roommate-3 rel-roommate)
